headline: U.S. Treasury Yields Ease Ahead of Jobs Data
detail: Falling Treasury yields can be supportive of growth stocks, as they reduce the discount rate for future earnings. This is generally a tailwind for your sector.
rec: Continue to monitor yield movements as they can influence tech valuations.
